title: CustomTypeCompact
description:
Full object requires scope: custom_types:read

Custom Types extend the types of Asana Objects.

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

name.description: The name of the custom type.

asana_created_type_identifier.description: *Read-only*. A stable identifier present when this custom type was created by Asana as part of an Asana product (for example, a Command ticket type or a Service queue type). `null` for custom types created by users, and for Asana-created types that do not have a public identifier yet. New values may be added over time as Asana products introduce new types; integrations should tolerate unrecognized values.
